title: Warning-reason registry
description: The values a warning carries in params.why, each the reason the warning of one code fired. See schemas/registry/README.md. tools/validate_warning_reasons.py checks sort order, uniqueness, that each code is a registered warning, that a published reason keeps its definition and params, and the package mirror, which this schema cannot express.

format_version.description: The registry format's own version, pinned to the version this schema validates.

entries.description: Every reason, sorted by code and then reason.

code.description: The warning code in registries/codes.json whose params.why carries the reason. An active reason needs an active code.

reason.description: The lower-snake-case spelling clients match on, unique within its code.

definition.description: One sentence saying what the reason means.

params.description: The params the warning carries beside why when it names this reason, each param name mapped to a one-sentence definition. Omitted when the reason adds none.

lifecycle.description: active while the warning can carry the reason; retired once it no longer does, which keeps the spelling and its meaning reserved. A published reason is never removed.
